title: Capital flows — income → liquidity → expense
notes: Income landings: Turo → X Money (Turo cannot deposit to Coinbase); Lyft + ASICs → Coinbase. Middle column is Liquidity & Collateral (X Money · Agentic fund · Coinbase top→bottom). Coinbase still hosts the Morpho path internally (BTC collateral → borrow USDC → High Yield vault) — collapsed on the map, not separate nodes. Expense top→bottom: Bills · One Card. Agentic funded weekly Mon from X Money.

braiins_pool.purpose: Read ASIC hashrate / payout stats directly instead of inferring from Coinbase deposits
braiins_pool.notes: Sync via treasury/braiins_sync.py → treasury/snapshots/braiins_latest.json. Token: ~/.config/braiins/token or BRAIINS_POOL_TOKEN. Create at pool.braiins.com → Settings → Access Profiles → Allow web APIs → Generate token. Account payout threshold: treasury/config.json braiins.payout_threshold_btc (0.01 as of 2026-08-05).
braiins_pool.cadence_hint: Poll daily or after expected payout window; FCC capital-flows reads braiins_latest.json live strip
